notAutoDetectable: Spatial coherence — whether elements enter/exit from where they logically belong (a menu growing from its anchor, a sheet rising from the edge it docks to). The audit sees durations and easings, not spatial origin.
Clean fades — whether opacity transitions are free of mid-fade color shifts, banding, or double-compositing. Only a human eye (or pixel diff) can judge fade quality.
Jump cuts — abrupt state changes with no transition where one is expected (content swaps, route changes). Absence of animation is not itself in the DOM.
Unified direction — whether a group of elements animates along a consistent axis/choreography rather than each doing its own thing.
Perceived hierarchy / emphasis — whether motion draws the eye to the right thing at the right time.
Content-appropriate personality — expressive vs. standard scheme being the right call for the brand and context.
Interruptibility & continuity — whether in-flight animations respond gracefully to new input rather than snapping.
Real contrast under imagery/gradients — text over photos or gradient backgrounds (the audit samples solid computed backgrounds only).
Closed shadow roots — their internals are structurally unreachable from script and are not scanned.
